generationInputs.prompt: A fair-skinned older woman with light gray shoulder-length wavy hair and wearing glasses stands behind a wooden table filled with various food items in a kitchen setting. The woman has an oval face with soft lines, a medium forehead partially covered by her light gray hair styled back, subtly marked cheekbones, and a soft, rounded jawline. Her medium-sized almond-shaped eyes with slightly droopy upper eyelids have dark irises, and her medium-thick, well-defined eyebrows arch subtly. She has a straight, medium-sized nose and medium-thick lips with a slight upward curve forming a subtle smile, revealing aligned natural teeth. Her ears are proportionate to her face, adorned with medium-sized gold hoop earrings. Her long, dense, smooth light gray hair is styled back, with some volume falling over her shoulders. She has a short to medium neck with a thin gold necklace featuring a small circular pendant, and her shoulders are straight and slightly back. She wears a dark gray V-neck blouse under a light beige cardigan. Her fair skin has a smooth texture with soft, diffused lighting from the front-left minimizing shadows and visible details. Her hands rest on the wooden table. The wooden table holds a small wooden bowl with green pumpkin seeds, a red bell pepper, a small wooden bowl of tan grains, a wooden cutting board with raw red meat, a clear glass of white liquid, a red apple, a green apple, a single avocado, a wooden bowl of red strawberries, and a bunch of yellow bananas. Behind the table and the woman is a kitchen with a lower backsplash of small brown and beige square tiles and muted beige walls above. Two wooden shelves are mounted on the wall, holding terra cotta bowls with yellow bananas, larger terra cotta bowls, a small terra cotta pot with a green leafy plant, a small terra cotta jar with a lid, a small glass jar, a small potted green plant, and a dark-colored mortar and pestle.
